metricHint.sttMinutes: Live speech transcribed while you lecture.
metricHint.audioRetention: How long the original recordings are kept before they are deleted.
metricHint.aiTokens: AI work across slide generation, refining, narration and quizzes. Metered in tokens: one slide-generation request runs about 3,500, and a 75-minute lecture around 2M.
metricHint.ttsCharacters: Narration you generate with a standard voice. Counted once, when a slide is first narrated — replaying it costs nothing.
metricHint.ttsPremiumCharacters: Narration generated with the more natural premium voices. Counted once, when a slide is first narrated — replaying it costs nothing.
metricHint.diarizationMinutes: Recorded audio you may label by speaker. Matches your recording allowance, so anything you record can also be labelled — it is a separate pass, run on the lectures that need it.
metricHint.translationCharacters: Lecture text you translate yourself. Counted once per lecture and language — the translation is stored and reused.
metricHint.aiImages: Images generated by AI for your slides.
metricHint.imageLookups: Slide images sourced from image search.
metricHint.exports: Downloads, exports to Drive, and quiz publishing.
metricHint.audioStorageMb: Retained lecture audio held at any one time.
metricHint.audienceTtsCharacters: Narration your viewers trigger, from a pool of its own so a popular lecture never spends yours. Counted once per slide, however many people listen.
metricHint.audienceLocales: Languages your viewers may have a lecture translated into. Counted once per language; everyone after the first viewer reads the stored translation.
